text: Pelican Watch 是适用于 DSH Web 的模型绘图探测插件。它在侧边栏提供看板，按设定间隔调用 DSH 模型服务，让所选模型生成同一道鹈鹕骑车 SVG 绘图，并将结果保存在本地供浏览。面板可选择模型、查看各模型的绘图和运行状态，也能调整间隔、暂停自动探测或手动发起探测。适合想持续观察不同模型输出变化的 DSH 用户。调用使用 DSH 已配置的模型提供方；插件本身不读取 API 密钥。

Pelican Watch periodically asks DSH models to draw a cycling pelican. Its sidebar board displays saved drawings and run status. Users can choose models, adjust the schedule, pause probing, or start a run manually. Results are stored locally through DSH providers; the plugin does not read API keys.
想定期让几个模型回答同一道绘图题，看看输出会不会变化。
DSH 有没有能把不同模型生成的图集中放在一个看板里的插件？
I want to periodically compare model drawings in a DSH panel.
Pelican Watch 的功能「定时模型绘图」：调度器按设定间隔调用所选模型，让每个模型完成同一绘图提示，并将生成结果保存到本地。用户可从面板暂停自动探测或立即发起一轮。
Pelican Watch 的功能「绘图看板」：侧边栏打开面板，按模型展示保存的绘图和运行信息；用户可在面板选择模型、查看图像、改变间隔或手动探测。
Pelican Watch 使用 DSH 模型服务向所选提供方发送固定绘图提示，并将模型返回结果写入本地目录；插件不读取 API 密钥。

A DeepSeek Harness **community plugin** that runs a long-term
**model-quality probe** (降智监测) on a schedule, across **any number of
models**:

@mi-lu-uncle/dsh-pelican-watch README · @mi-lu-uncle/dsh-pelican-watch：- **Pick your models** — the gear in the panel's top-right corner lists every model the
  configured providers report (live `/models` discovery, merged with the models
  in your DSH profile) and probes a multi-selected set, each model through its
  own provider and API key.
- **Scheduled drawing** — every 30 minutes (configurable) each selected model is
  asked to draw an **animated** *pelican riding a bicycle*: a single-file HTML
  page with an inline SVG whose motion is SVG declarative animation (`<animate>`
  / `<animateTransform>`).
- **No skills, no tools** — each run is a bare `chat/completions` request with
  no tool definitions and no agent loop, so the result measures the model
  alone, never your local skills.
- **Everything flat, nothing to click** — the main board is read-only: one band
  per model, its status and figures on the left (when its newest drawing landed,
  runs, average duration, how many came back without a drawing, and the failure
  reason) and every drawing it ever made on the right, all laid out at once —
  nothing collapsed, filtered, or hidden behind a click.

@mi-lu-uncle/dsh-pelican-watch README · Install：From this GitHub repository (recommended):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/mi-lu-uncle/dsh-pelican-watch.git
```

Or from a local path or tarball:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /absolute/path/to/dsh-pelican-watch
```

Note: `link:`-installed plugins are not watched by HMR, so editing
`lib/index.js` or `lib/client.js` requires an app restart to take effect.

@mi-lu-uncle/dsh-pelican-watch README · Choosing models：The gear in the panel's top-right corner opens the settings sheet, which lists
**every provider route registered in DSH** — the signed-in 「DeepSeek 账号」
account, the official API-key route, and any third-party provider you configured
— grouped by the display name DSH uses, each with the models it advertises. Tick
any number of models and **Save models**: from the next cycle on each selected
model draws its own picture and gets its own band on the board.

@mi-lu-uncle/dsh-pelican-watch README · Choosing models：**The board shows exactly the selected models**, in the order they were saved —
a band never jumps around. Unticking a model and saving **deletes its drawings**:
anything the board cannot show is only invisible dead weight on disk, and these
probe drawings are meant to be re-drawn anyway. The save toast says how many went.

@mi-lu-uncle/dsh-pelican-watch README · Choosing models：A model id is not unique: the signed-in account and a third-party provider can
both serve `deepseek-flash`. A band is therefore a **provider + model** pair, and
it carries the provider's display name next to the model name — two providers
never share one band, nor one another's drawings.

@mi-lu-uncle/dsh-pelican-watch README · Choosing models：The plugin never touches key material: calls go through DSH's model service
(`ctx.llm`), which resolves the credential itself. That is why the
account-backed provider (no API key at all, just a signed-in account) can be
probed here, and why any provider that works in DSH works here. A provider that
cannot list its models (not signed in, expired key) still appears, with the
reason attached.

@mi-lu-uncle/dsh-pelican-watch README · Choosing models：| key | default | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `autoEnabled` | `true` | Off disarms the timer at once (`nextRunAt` goes empty); only the manual “probe now” then spends anything, and the choice survives a restart. |
| `intervalMinutes` | follows `config.intervalMinutes` (30) | Changing it in the panel re-arms the countdown immediately — no restart. |
`config.model` / `config.targets` only seed the very first run. At most 12
models are probed per cycle — `concurrency` of them at the same time (3 by
default), one drawing each.

@mi-lu-uncle/dsh-pelican-watch README · Speed and timeouts：- **Models run in parallel** (3 at a time by default), so one slow model no
  longer delays the others: every drawing is written to disk the moment it
  arrives and shows up in the panel within seconds.
- **Each request has its own timeout** (`timeoutSeconds`, default 600). A model
  that exceeds it is reported as `超过 N 秒没有返回` on its own band instead of
  hanging the whole pass. Reasoning models can genuinely be slow — measured
  against one provider: `qwen3.7-max` ~52s, `deepseek-flash` ~121s (15k of those
  completion tokens were reasoning), while `glm-5.3-flash` sometimes exceeded
  4 minutes.
- **A timeout or HTTP error is not a drawing**: nothing is saved and it does not
  count as a drawing, because that is an infrastructure fact rather than model
  behaviour. A model that *answers* without an SVG (a refusal) is saved and
  marked `没出图` — that is the signal worth looking at.
- `maxTokens` is not sent by default: reasoning models spend tens of thousands of
  completion tokens before they draw, and a tight ceiling would truncate the SVG
  instead of speeding anything up.

`pelican-watch` row in your profile patch (`cordis.patch.yml`):

```yaml
- id: pelican-watch
  config:
    # initial selection (the panel's picker wins once used)
    provider: deepseek-account           # a DSH provider route; account by default

The benchmark prompt is deliberately fixed — changing it makes the history
incomparable, so treat `prompt` as a last resort.

@mi-lu-uncle/dsh-pelican-watch README · Configuration：The animation has to be SMIL, and that is not a preference: the panel shows the extracted SVG through an ``, and a browser running an SVG *as an image* **does not play CSS animations and never runs scripts** — only declarative SMIL moves. An animated picture driven by `@keyframes` or `

@mi-lu-uncle/dsh-pelican-watch README · Credentials：This plugin has **no** API-key configuration of its own. It calls models through
DSH's model service (`ctx.llm`), which resolves the credential: an API-key route
uses the key DSH stores for it, `deepseek-account` uses the account you signed
in with. So:

@mi-lu-uncle/dsh-pelican-watch README · Display only — no scoring：This plugin **does not score anything**. It does two things: it asks every model
the same drawing prompt on a schedule, and it lays the drawings out as they are.

@mi-lu-uncle/dsh-pelican-watch README · Display only — no scoring：Earlier versions computed a 0-100 "structural score" offline (is there an SVG, two
wheels, a frame, wings…). That has been removed on request: such a number can
only approximate “did these elements appear”, and it lends a false precision.
The judgement is left to whoever looks at the pictures (or to a vision model):
**same prompt, same model, over consecutive days — the drawings themselves are
the finding**, and no digit has to stand in for them.

@mi-lu-uncle/dsh-pelican-watch README · Display only — no scoring：The numbers that remain on the board are not grades, just facts: how many runs,
average duration, when the newest drawing landed, and how many runs came back
without a drawing. `没有出图` means the request returned but carried no usable
SVG (typically a refusal). The raw answer is stored on disk next to the SVG,
  but the panel never renders it — clicking a drawing shows the picture alone.

@mi-lu-uncle/dsh-pelican-watch README · Storage：Drawings live in `dir` (default `~/.dsh/pelican-watch`): | File | Role | |---|---| | `<时间>_<模型>.html` | The full generated page; first line is a meta comment (model, provider, time, duration, whether an SVG was detected) | | `<时间>_<模型>.svg` | The extracted inline SVG, used for the panel's `` preview | | `settings.json` | The selected probe targets (written by the picker) plus the two pace knobs `autoEnabled` / `intervalMinutes` |
@mi-lu-uncle/dsh-pelican-watch README · Storage：Deleting files there is safe; the panel always lists what is on disk.

@mi-lu-uncle/dsh-pelican-watch README · Privacy & safety：- Every route is same-origin fenced like other plugin surfaces. - Drawings are served as `image/svg+xml` with `x-content-type-options: nosniff` and a `default-src 'none'` CSP, and are only ever shown through ``: the model's surrounding prose, markdown fences and any `

|---|---|
| `lib/index.js` | Host half: multi-model scheduler, schedule control, storage, `/api/pelican-watch/*` routes |
| `lib/client.js` | Client half: the flat board (one band per model with all its drawings) plus the gear-opened settings sheet (React) |

@mi-lu-uncle/dsh-pelican-watch README · @mi-lu-uncle/dsh-pelican-watch：[English](README.md) | 简体中文 | [日本語](README.ja.md)

一个 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）**社区插件**：按固定间隔对**任意多个模型**运行**长期降智探针**。

@mi-lu-uncle/dsh-pelican-watch README · @mi-lu-uncle/dsh-pelican-watch：- **自己挑模型** — 面板右上角「设置」里的「检测的模型」会列出各 provider 提供的全部模型（实时调 `/models` 发现，并合并你 DSH profile 里已配置的模型），可多选；每个模型走自己的 provider 与 API Key。
- **定时作画** — 每 30 分钟（可配置）让每个已选模型画一个**会动**的「鹈鹕骑车」：单文件 HTML，画面是内联 SVG，动效必须是 SVG 声明式动画（`<animate>` / `<animateTransform>`）。
- **不用技能、不用工具** — 每次都是裸的 `chat/completions` 请求：不带工具定义、不走 agent 循环，测的只是模型本身，和你的本地技能无关。
- **全部平铺、零点击** — 主面板是只读的：每个模型一条横幅，左边是它的状态和指标（最新一张的时间、跑了几次、平均耗时、没出图几次，以及失败原因），右边是它画过的每一张，一次铺满整页 —— 不折叠、不筛选、不需要点任何东西。
- **跑动状态在顶部** — 检测中直接显示「已完成 n/m」「正在检测哪个模型」「已等 m:ss」「超时上限 m:ss」，一眼分清「慢」和「卡住」。
- **动作就在面板右上角** — 一个「设置」按钮弹出面板内的设置窗：挑模型、暂停/恢复自动检测、改间隔、停止本轮；「全部检测一遍」就在它左边。**只想测一个模型**时，点它那条横幅上的「单独检测」：只发一个请求，不动其它模型，也不等别的模型跑完（可以同时点好几个）。看板本身只负责展示，不看设置也能读到全部信息。点任意一张画只是把它放大 —— **只有图，没有文字**。
- **随时停、随时改间隔** — 面板右上角「设置」里可以直接**暂停/恢复自动检测**、改**检测间隔**（1–1440 分钟）、以及**停止正在跑的这一轮**（正在进行的请求会被立刻中断，还没开始的模型直接跳过、不再发请求）。暂停会立刻写入 `settings.json`，重启也保持暂停 —— 只想手动测的时候，一分钱 token 都不会自动花。
- **有界历史** — **每个模型**默认保留最新 10 张，旧的自动清理；这个额度不会被同时在检测的几个模型瓜分，同名模型在不同 provider 下也各存各的。同一道题、同一个模型、坚持几天，退化会直接体现在结构变差、拒画（会保存并标上「未检出 SVG」）、或耗时变长上。

@mi-lu-uncle/dsh-pelican-watch README · 安装：推荐从 GitHub 仓库安装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/mi-lu-uncle/dsh-pelican-watch.git
```

也支持本地路径或 tarball：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /absolute/path/to/dsh-pelican-watch
```

注意：以 `link:` 方式安装的插件不走 HMR 监听，修改 `lib/index.js` 或 `lib/client.js` 后需要重启 App 才能生效。

@mi-lu-uncle/dsh-pelican-watch README · 选择模型：| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `autoEnabled` | `true` | 关掉后定时器立刻停摆（`nextRunAt` 变空），只有手动「全部检测一遍」才会花钱；重启后保持关。 |
| `intervalMinutes` | 跟随 `config.intervalMinutes`（30） | 面板上改完立即按新间隔重新计时，不用重启。 |

两个键都会在**校验通过后**才生效：比如一次请求里同时给了合法的 `autoEnabled` 和非法的间隔，整条请求会被拒绝，运行中的调度不会被改一半。

@mi-lu-uncle/dsh-pelican-watch README · 速度与超时：- **模型并行检测**（默认同时 3 个）：一个慢模型不再拖住其他人——每张画一画完就落盘，几秒内出现在面板里。
- **每个请求有独立超时**（`timeoutSeconds`，默认 600 秒）。超时只在**它自己**那条横幅上显示「超过 N 秒没有返回」，不会卡住整轮。推理型模型确实可能很慢——同一 provider 实测：`qwen3.7-max` 约 52 秒、`deepseek-flash` 约 121 秒（其中 1.5 万 token 是"思考"），而 `glm-5.3-flash` 有时超过 4 分钟。
- **超时或 HTTP 报错不算画**：既不落盘也不计入出图，因为那是基础设施问题、不是模型表现。而模型**答了却没画**（拒答）会被保存下来、标成「没出图」——那才是值得看的信号。
- 默认**不发送** `maxTokens`：推理型模型动笔前可能花掉几万 completion token，卡一个上限只会把 SVG 截断，并不会更快。
- **被截断的画会被明确报告**：如果回答在输出上限处停下（SVG 只写了一半），面板显示「回答被截断（已输出 N tokens）：SVG 没有画完，多半是达到模型的输出上限」，而不是含糊的「未检出 SVG」，也不会把半张残图存进历史。真要放宽，就在配置里设 `maxTokens`。

@mi-lu-uncle/dsh-pelican-watch README · 配置：默认值贴合常见配置；如需覆盖，在 profile 补丁（`cordis.patch.yml`）的 `pelican-watch` 行上设置： ```yaml - id: pelican-watch config: # 初始选择（面板里选过之后以面板为准） provider: deepseek-account # DSH 的提供方路由；默认 deepseek-account 基准提示词是刻意固定的——改了它历史就不可比了，所以 `prompt` 请当作最后手段。 提示词要求动效必须用 SVG 声明式动画（`` / ``），这不是偏好：面板用 `` 显示提取出来的 SVG，浏览器在"SVG 当图片"时**不播放 CSS 动画、也永远不执行脚本**，只有 SMIL 会动。如果是自己改提示词，`

@mi-lu-uncle/dsh-pelican-watch README · 凭据：这个插件**没有**自己的 API Key 配置：它通过 DSH 的模型服务（`ctx.llm`）调用模型，凭据完全由 DSH 解析——API Key 路由用它自己存的 key，`deepseek-account` 用你登录的账号。所以：

- 想检测哪个模型，先在 DSH 里让那个提供方可用（设置 → 模型），这里就能直接选；
- 换 key、重新登录都不用改插件配置；
- 面板和接口里**不会出现任何密钥**（插件根本不读它）。

调不通时面板会按失败原因说人话：`需要先在 DSH 里登录 DeepSeek 账号`、`这个提供方还没有配置凭据`、`被限流了`、`额度不足`、`超出模型的上下文窗口` 等。

@mi-lu-uncle/dsh-pelican-watch README · 存储：画保存在 `dir`（默认 `~/.dsh/pelican-watch`）： | 文件 | 作用 | |---|---| | `<时间>_<模型>.html` | 生成的完整页面；首行是元信息注释（模型、provider、时间、耗时、是否检出 SVG） | | `<时间>_<模型>.svg` | 抽取出的内联 SVG，供面板 `` 预览使用 | | `settings.json` | 已选中的探测目标（由选择器写入）+ 两个节奏开关 `autoEnabled` / `intervalMinutes` | 手动删除这里的文件是安全的；面板永远以磁盘上的现状为准。

@mi-lu-uncle/dsh-pelican-watch README · 隐私与安全：- 所有路由与其他插件一致，做了同源校验。 - 画作只以 `image/svg+xml` + `x-content-type-options: nosniff` + `default-src 'none'` 的 CSP 返回，并且只通过 `` 展示：模型围在 SVG 外面的那段说明文字、markdown 围栏、以及任何 `

@mi-lu-uncle/dsh-pelican-watch README · 布局：| 文件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `lib/index.js` | Host 半：多模型调度器、调度控制、存储、`/api/pelican-watch/*` 路由（模型调用走 `ctx.llm`，不碰密钥） |
| `lib/client.js` | Client 半：平铺看板（每个模型一条横幅 + 它的全部画作）+ 右上角「设置」窗（React） |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Bundle 补丁，把本包作为一个 host 行挂载 |
| `package.json` | npm 元数据 + `dsh.bundle`/`dsh.client`/`dsh.compatibility` |
| `test/pelican.test.mjs` | 离线测试：按模型汇总、provider 解析、目标选择、调度控制、路由接线 |
